answer_1.quote: We propose CRScore, an automated but reference-free evaluation metric that uses dimensions of review quality from prior work.
answer_1.outputs: natural language review comments for code changes

answer_2.quote: We compare CRScore with 7 reference-based metrics, for 9 review generation systems using the collected annotations.

answer_3.quote: LLM-as-a-judge (LaaJ): Following recent developments (Zheng et al., 2023) we develop an LLM prompting-based approach that compares the model-generated reviews against CodeReviewer references to generate relevance scores.
methods: LLM prompting-based approach with descriptions of conciseness, comprehensiveness, and relevance dimensions

answer_4.quote: We gather annotations from the same annotators on reviews generated by 9 systems (section 4.4) and the ground truth references.
answer_4.guideline: Raters follow a codebook that contains guidelines and examples for annotating each dimension using the pseudo-references on a 5-point Likert scale. They rate conciseness, comprehensiveness, and relevance.
